lessons: When a destination is gated by a scheduled world event (e.g., a repair crew clearing a blockage on a specific day), check the schedule before attempting the route and wait or plan around it rather than retrying the blocked path.
To reach a chest tile, navigate with directional inputs and confirm interactions with the A button
Short delegated goals can often be completed in a few body tasks; verify position before interacting
To reach a distant tile, chain short directional inputs (e.g., DPadRight then DPadUp) and confirm with ControllerA when interacting.
When a delegated goal names a target tile, navigate to it and stand on it rather than just approaching.
To open a chest and claim its contents, approach the chest tile and press the interact button (ControllerA)
Short DPad taps move one tile at a time; chain them to navigate to a target tile
When a goal is a specific tile, navigate by short directional inputs and confirm arrival rather than exploring.
Companion should report goal completion concisely once the target tile is reached.
When a crafting station is locked behind a keyed door, check for a scheduled key vendor and wait for the earliest visit day rather than searching for alternate routes.
Crafting tasks may require navigating to a workbench through a locked door; plan around vendor schedules before attempting the craft.
If the body becomes immobile on a special tile (e.g., Notice Board), treat it as a soft-lock: stop retrying movement/interaction and report the stuck state rather than burning many tasks on it.
When a delegated crafting goal requires reaching a workbench, first verify the body can move off its starting tile before attempting navigation.
